title.rendered: Container Offices for Sale in Bannerghatta Road

content.rendered:
Looking for a container office for sale in Bannerghatta Road? SAMAN Portable is a direct manufacturer of steel-framed container offices, built at our Bengaluru factory and delivered ready to use across south Bengaluru. We supply 10ft, 20ft and 40ft units for site offices, sales offices, admin cabins and back-office space — made to order, not pulled from a used-container yard.

Container offices for sale in Bannerghatta Road

A container office in Bannerghatta Road is a factory-built steel office unit delivered to your site complete with flooring, wiring points, lighting, doors and windows. SAMAN Portable manufactures each unit on an MS steel frame to IS 2062, finishes it at our Gopasandra plant in Bengaluru 560099, and transports it to your Bannerghatta Road address — typically ready to occupy the day it lands. It suits project sites, clinics, institutions and offices along the corridor that need workspace quickly.

Container office sizes we supply

We build three standard footprints. Each can be fitted with electrical points, lighting, windows, a door and an optional toilet or pantry. Layouts are made to order, so you confirm the use case and we configure the unit before dispatch.

SizeApprox. footprintBest for
10ft10ft x 8ft (approx.)Solo cabin, security/site office, small admin desk
20ft20ft x 8ft (approx.)Team office of 4–8, sales office, meeting space
40ft40ft x 8ft (approx.)Larger team office, multi-cabin layout, combined work + meeting areas

Need a size in between or two units joined together? Container offices are stackable and modular, so we can combine units into a larger office. Tell us the headcount and we will recommend the footprint.

Why buy your container office direct from SAMAN

Buying direct from the manufacturer means you deal with the people who actually build the unit — no marketplace markup and no guessing about quality.

  • Steel that is specified, not assumed: every container office is built on an MS steel frame to IS 2062, the same structural steel standard used across our range.
  • Factory-built quality: manufactured and finished at our Gopasandra, Bengaluru 560099 unit by a company holding ISO 9001:2015.
  • Warranty you can hold us to: 5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. (The 20–25 years is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period.)
  • Clear delivery terms: delivery from ₹3,000 with transit of 3–5 days to most Bengaluru addresses.
  • Returns: within 7 days of delivery or installation.

Delivery and installation in Bannerghatta Road

Bannerghatta Road runs through south Bengaluru towards our Gopasandra factory belt, so units reach the locality quickly. We deliver the finished container office on a truck, position it with a crane or hydraulic offload where access allows, and set it on a level base. Once placed, a container office needs only a power connection and any optional water line before it is usable — there is no slow on-site construction.

Please confirm site access in advance: a clear approach for the delivery truck and enough room to offload the unit. If your Bannerghatta Road site is tight on access, tell us at enquiry stage and we will plan the offload.

Get a container office quote in Bannerghatta Road

Pricing depends on size (10ft / 20ft / 40ft) and the fittings you choose — toilet, pantry, extra windows, partitions or air-conditioning points. For a current quote on a container office in Bannerghatta Road, call SAMAN Portable on +91 88616 22859 or use Send Enquiry with your size and layout, and we will share the price and lead time. You can also browse our full container office range to see configurations before you enquire.

FAQs


What sizes of container office can I buy in Bannerghatta Road?

We supply 10ft, 20ft and 40ft container offices. A 10ft unit suits a solo cabin or site office, a 20ft unit suits a small team, and a 40ft unit suits larger teams or a combined work-and-meeting layout. Units can also be joined for more space.


How long does delivery to Bannerghatta Road take?

Transit to most Bengaluru addresses, including Bannerghatta Road, is typically 3–5 days once your order and layout are confirmed, with delivery from ₹3,000. Final timing depends on the configuration and current production schedule.


Can the container office be customised?

Yes. Each unit is made to order — you choose the layout, windows, doors, and optional toilet, pantry, partitions or air-conditioning points. Tell us the use case and headcount and we configure the unit before dispatch.


What is the warranty on a SAMAN container office?

5 years structural frame and base + 1–2 years finishing + 20–25 years engineered service life. The 20–25 years is the engineered service life of the structure, not a warranty period.


Are these new or used container offices?

New. Every unit is freshly manufactured to order on an MS steel frame at our Gopasandra, Bengaluru factory — we do not supply used or second-hand containers.


How do I order a container office in Bannerghatta Road?

Call +91 88616 22859 or use Send Enquiry with your preferred size, intended use and Bannerghatta Road delivery address. We confirm the configuration, price and lead time, then build and deliver the finished unit.

With over 15 years of industry experience, Aman has helped global clients optimize design, streamline production, and amplify brand visibility through data-driven content and strategic SEO. Under his guidance, Saman Portable has become a trusted name in container office solutions and turnkey prefabricated buildings across India and beyond.
